[h2]Fun with friends, but some issues prevented it from hitting jackpot[/h2]
The quintessential 'sideways' thumb applied here.

I cant remember the last time I played a game with friends for 12 hours straight, but Gamble With Your Friends managed just that. It's chaotic, frustrating, funny even when not trying to and it will crush your hopes with a roll of the dice.

So, what is it? it's a gambling coop roguelike: each day you make money by betting on some casino games trying to meet a quota to advance to the next day. This goes on for a total of 12 days. Every 4th day the next floor will open. Each day you have bonus challenges you can complete for tickets, which you can use for consumable items to improve your odds or customization options, of which there are quite a lot. There are a total of 3 endings too so there's some replay value.

There's 17 games in total, from Blackjack, to roulette, Keno, Plinko and Slot machines, duck races and 1P poker among others. It's got that silly and approachable vibe, meaning if your group of friends enjoys peak and other friend-driven games you will definitely enjoy this one.

Hardest friendslop game I've ever played, and thus the most entertaining one I've done with the handful of friends I actually have. I've had 0 performance/lag issues and the extra features such as the gadgets, ticket system, the loan shark challenges and such do a fine enough job of adding variety to your playthroughs on top of the great multitude of gambling games already here.

As a side note, this might have the most unique lobby I've seen in a multiplayer game before. You can do a lot from playing basketball, chess, checkers, or straight-up dismembering your friends against their will if you so choose.

The game has potential. The one thing it is lacking is "relics" of any kind. Sure, you can have items that boost outcomes or can revert outcomes entirely. But there needs to be items that give you perks throughout the run you can compound on. As it stands, you are literally just gambling with friends against the house odds. Mid to late game (if you can get there) becomes an item stacking gamble to get one big hit to progress. If it doesn't pan out, your run is 100% luck based, and the house always wins. So you're going to lose most of the time with nothing to aid you in future runs. I'd enjoy a casual mode with no time limits and a way to make money to keep gambling. Thumbs up because of price point, but it NEEDS something to prolong runs to prevent burnout. Strong Maybe so far.

Honestly, if you're looking for a game that will make you genuinely hate and love your friends at the same time, this is it. I grabbed it on a whim because it was cheap, but I didn't expect it to be such a high stakes fever dream. The concept is basically you and your boys share one bank account and a massive debt to a loan shark who will absolutely wreck you if you're short. You either win together or you all go broke/die together.

​It is pure chaos. The ticking clock and that daily debt quota actually make your heart race. Also, there are sketchy items you can use to cheat the odds add so much more depth of strategy than just mindlessly clicking buttons. Right now there are about 17 games randomly spread across 4 casino floor and boss area. There’s no random matchmaking, and honestly, playing solo is a miserable experience

​It’s easily one of the best co-op experiences I’ve had lately. It tests your teamwork, but more importantly, it tests your greed. If you like the gameplay loop vibes of Lethal Company or Phasmophobia but mixed with casino mechanics and gambling addiction that make you scream at your monitor in both joy and total despair, just get it.
